hints.title: Rolling Ball Exploration
hints.text: Explore reachable stopping positions. From each stopping point, roll in all four cardinal directions until hitting a wall or border.

hints.title: Tracking Visited Stopping Cells
hints.text: Maintain a visited set for cells where the ball stops. Intermediate cells rolled through do not count as stops and need not be marked as visited.

hints.title: Breadth-First Rolling Traversal
hints.text: Initialize a queue with the start coordinates and mark it visited. While the queue has elements, pop the current coordinates. For each direction step forward until a wall or boundary is encountered, then back up one step. If this stopping position equals destination, return true. Otherwise if unvisited, mark it and enqueue.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal O(M * N) time bounded by expanding each cell as a stop position at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Stepping cell by cell leads to cyclic states if visited states are not tied to full stops.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking visited stop locations ensures each cell is expanded at most once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Ball rolls continuously until hitting a boundary or wall; intermediate positions are not valid stop states.
